subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing dramatic structure and conventions in a play text
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student maps a play's events onto a dramatic structure diagram (exposition, rising action, climax, resolution)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a play excerpt to the dramatic convention it demonstrates (soliloquy, aside, dramatic irony)
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a dramatic convention functions within a given play excerpt

misconception_flags: confuses a soliloquy (character alone, speaking their thoughts) with dialogue directed at another character

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
